# Minds Studio Product Guide

> Independent product walkthrough of https://minds.email, observed 26–27 October 2026. Not official documentation.

Minds Studio is a multi-agent workspace that connects Mail, AI collaborators called Minds, Projects, Tasks and recurring work. In Work mode, users can manage and send email manually or delegate email-related work to a Mind. Minds do not each automatically receive an email address.

Users can give Minds recognizable identities, abilities, memory and Project context, then delegate through chat, email-related workflows, dictation or voice. Work is supervised through a Taskboard and a Dashboard showing status, time saved, energy, activity and spend.

Canonical files:
- README.md
- PRODUCT_INTRODUCTION.md
- PRODUCT_OVERVIEW.md
- FEATURES.md
- USER_FLOWS.md
- ARCHITECTURE.md
- IMPLEMENTATION_ROADMAP.md
- feature-catalog.json
- llms-full.txt

Important terms:
- Mail: a Work-mode surface for manual email and delegation of email-related work to a Mind.
- Mind: an AI collaborator with a recognizable role, profile and ongoing context.
- Project: a private container for chats, files and Tasks.
- Taskboard: the human-supervised work lifecycle.
- Energy: the product’s usage or budget abstraction.
- Discover: a feed whose items can become private conversations or recurring work.
- Pod: an experimental team of Minds, enabled through Settings → Experimental → Pods in Work mode; device-specific.
- Companion: an experimental integration surface for proactive or scheduled work.
